items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: oh, I don't know she knew Bessie

ctx.x: She loved her. I don't know whether she -- I don't know if she knew Helen, I don't remember that. I don't know how well she knew Helen, if she saw -- Helen's not her type anyway, is she -- Helen Humes is not Mildred's type. Billie was much more.
Mildred respected other singers, she liked, you know, she enjoyed hearing other singers, but -- herself. People she liked -- oh, I don't know she knew Bessie --
